newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 10.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Peasant producers say individual buyers and exporters buy coffee at prices far below the officially recommended 495 CFA francs a kilo.

- Managing Director of Ivory Coast's privatised telecommunications company CI-TELCOM will be assisted by nine directors, including three Ivorians. France Cables et Radios, a subsidiary of France Telecom, took a majority stake of the company in February.
- Violent strike over pay at south western plantation run by Ivorian rubber company SOGB ; more than 100 labourers sacked for stopping work unlawfully
- Taxation officers union SYNAFISC threatens unlimited strike over plan to take away responsibilities for tax collection
- Newly privatised state telecommunications company CI-TELCOM plans to provide 250,000 new lines by the end of 1997.
